purpose: Reproducible catalogue of public hydrological observations and independent historical flood evidence candidates. Downloading or auditing data does not establish that it is suitable as a predictive label. INDOFLOODS event records are a promising candidate for gauge-event outcome review, but must not be treated as a Kochi training dataset until geographic coverage, station identity, temporal alignment, licence and non-event sampling are validated.

download_policy.reuse_note: Preserve attribution and raw source bytes. Verify current source licence before redistribution; where the applicable licence is unclear, use only for cautious internal analysis until clarified.

evaluation_gate.reason: Hydrological measurements and hazard maps are not equivalent to independently verified, time-aligned flood outcomes.
minimum_requirements: Validate timestamps, units, station identifiers, coordinates, missingness and duplicate/conflicting keys.
Resolve gauge datum/reference and official station-specific thresholds before interpreting river levels.
Obtain independently verified outcomes with spatial unit, time interval, target definition and evidence source.
Set prediction issue time and horizon before selecting features; exclude information unavailable at issue time.
Use chronological/event-grouped holdout and compare against a simple baseline.
Report event and sample counts, class balance, confusion matrix, precision, recall and F1; do not claim model skill if data are insufficient.
